SkillUnlock_Kitsunebi.desc:
Harness for holding Foxparks.
Activate its Partner Skill to hold Foxparks
and attack using it as a flamethrower.

Arrow_Poison.desc:
Poison Arrows for use with bows. 
Afflicts target with Poison on contact.
Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

SkillUnlock_Monkey_Fire.desc:
Assault rifle made specifically for Tanzee Ignis.
Activate its Partner Skill, and Tanzee Ignis will enter gunner mode
and begin shooting at nearby enemies.

Processed_Wood.desc:
Planks made from processed wood for easier use.
More versatile than raw logs, with a wide variety of uses.
Can be crafted at Primitive Workbench.

Lab.desc:
A facility for conducting research on the various tasks of Pals. 
By assigning tasks to Pals in this facility, research progresses, granting various benefits.

DimensionPalStorage.desc:
A facility for storing a large number of captured Pals. 
Any guild member can deposit or withdraw Pals.
If you set it to private, it can serve as your personal Pal storage.

Battle_RangeWeapon_SphereLauncher_Once.desc:
A launcher that fires spheres.
It can capture Pals from a greater distance.

UnlockEquipmentSlot_Weapon_01.desc:
A holster that allows an additional weapon to be equipped.
While in possession, it increases weapon equip slots by 1.
Carrying one is enough.

BaseCampWorkHard02.desc:
A refined monitoring station with improved materials and structure.
In addition to being able to issue work orders, the system also lowers the SAN cost for Pals working at the base. 
Working conditions are slightly improved, making Pals less likely to become dissatisfied.

Infra_ElectronicCircuit.desc:
Required to create precision equipment.
Can be made with a Production Assembly Line.

GuildChest.desc:
A chest that can instantly send and receive items through subspace. 
The items inside are shared across all bases where it is placed.

Bio_Battery.desc:
A device that stores bio-energy as electrical power.
Used for equipment requiring high energy density.
Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

SkillUnlock_LazyDragon.desc:
Makes Relaxaurus fire a missile launcher
when ridden.

SkillUnlock_LazyDragon_Electric.desc:
Makes Relaxaurus Lux fire a missile launcher
when ridden.

SkillUnlock_GrassGolem.desc:
Saddle for safely riding Dualith. 
Grants the ability to fire a powerful Grass-element laser while mounted.

BaseCampItemDispenser.desc: A device that lets you freely access items from all chests in the base.

A shotgun for Nyafia to hold.

LaserMiningTool.desc:
A portable plasma cutter that concentrates and emits plasma energy.
It supports a wide range of uses, from ore excavation to tree cutting.
Its high-output energy also allows for the mining of special ores.Logging/Mining Yield Up

UnlockEquipmentSlot_Weapon_02.desc:
A holster that lets you equip additional weapons.
When in inventory, adds an extra weapon slot.
Carrying one is enough.

SkillUnlock_IceSeal_Ground.desc: Saddle for safely riding Polapup Terra.

MedicalPalBed_05.desc:
A healing pod for Pals.
Used when Pals are injured or to rest at night.
Thanks to technological advancements, the healing amount has increased.

MultiElectricHatchingPalEgg.desc:
Device for incubating Pal eggs.
While power supply is required, it allows multiple eggs to be incubated simultaneously at the optimal temperature.

Armor made of Hexolite.

Thermal_Core.desc:
A high-temperature reaction core containing vast thermal energy.
Used as a power component in advanced devices.
Can be crafted at Production Assembly Line II.

Spa3.desc:
Facility where Pals on base can rest. 
Its calming, traditional Japanese design offers an extra boost to SAN recovery.

SkillUnlock_Kirin_Ice.desc: Saddle for safely riding Univolt Cryst.

SkyislandIngot.desc:
An ancient metal refined from ore that slumbers in Sunreach. 
A rare processed material, forming the foundation of high-grade equipment and structures.
Can be refined at Ancient Furnace.

SkillUnlock_KingSunfish_Thunder.desc: Saddle for safely riding Solmora Lux.

WaterBuildKit.desc:
Construction kit that allows foundations
to be placed on water.

SkyBowArrow.desc:
Enhanced arrows for shooting with Mechanical Bow.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.

AIcore.desc:
A core component essential to cutting-edge devices, enabling complex decision-making and autonomous control.
Can be crafted at Advanced Workshop.

SkySubmachineGunBullet.desc:
Ammo for the Combat SMG.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.

AncientArmor.desc:
Ancient armor forged from Soralite Ingot.
Crafted with the essence of a lost civilization, it boasts overwhelming defensive power and is capable of withstanding cataclysmic threats.Cold Resistance Lv. 2 Heat Resistance Lv. 2 Attack Up (S) Lv. 4

AncientHelmet.desc:
An ancient helmet forged from Soralite Ingot.
It is imbued with wisdom passed down through the ages, protecting its wearer with unwavering strength.
Its defensive capabilities far surpass those of modern equipment.Neutral Damage Reduction Lv. 1 Dragon Damage Reduction Lv. 1

SkyShotgunBullet.desc:
Ammo for the Prototype Shotgun.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.

SkillUnlock_GrassGolem_Dark.desc:
Saddle for safely riding Dualith Noct. 
Grants the ability to fire a powerful Dark-element laser while mounted.

SkyAssaultRifleBullet.desc:
Ammo for the Heavy Assault Rifle.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.

AncientCookingStove.desc:
A special kitchen based on ancient technology that can create everything from existing dishes to entirely new recipes.
It retains heat through fire and completes cooking with manual preparation, allowing it to prepare any kind of cuisine.
It requires Pals with high-level Kindling and Handiwork suitability.

SkillUnlock_VolcanoDragon_Ice.desc: Saddle for safely riding Moldron Cryst.

Shield_07.desc:
A shield created using lost ancient technology.
It automatically repairs itself after not taking damage for a while. 
Its performance is said to be impossible to reproduce in the modern era.

BaseCampWorkHard03.desc:
A monitoring station based on ancient technology, embedded with Red Paldium.
It issues commands across the entire base through a holographic interface, reducing SAN depletion in Pals.
A special wavelength surrounds the base, keeping Pals calm even in harsh working environments.

SkillUnlock_ThunderBird_Ice.desc: Saddle for safely riding Beakon Cryst.

SkyGrenadeLauncherBullet.desc:
Ammo for the Tactical Grenade Launcher.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.

Ancient_Clinic.desc:
A top-tier medical facility that reproduces advanced ancient medical technology.
It offers significantly greater protective capability than a standard clinic.
By assigning a Pal with Medicine Production suitability, even bases with harsh working conditions can maintain the highest level of hygiene.

Ancient_MedicalPalBed.desc:
A ulitmate Pal Bed made from ancient recovery pod with soft matress.
It offers one of the highest SAN recovery rates of all Pal beds, quickly relieving fatigue.
It is the same size as a Large Pal Bed, allowing large Pals to rest comfortably.

PalSphere_Ancient_2.desc:
A tool that captures Pals when thrown.
An ultimate Sphere created as the pinnacle of an ancient civilization, imbued with the power of the World Tree.

WidePenetrateShotgunBullet.desc:
Ammo for the Beam Scatter.
Can be crafted at Ancient Workbench.

A highly efficient power generator restored from lost ancient technology.
It produces massive amounts of electricity, but is prone to overheating while in operation.
It requires Pals with high-level Generating Electricity and any level of Watering suitability.

SkillUnlock_CubeTurtle_Neutral.desc: Saddle for safely riding Tetroise Primo.

Ancient_Spa.desc:
A hot spring built with ancient technology, filled with special water infused with Paldium.
It offers the highest SAN recovery of all hot springs and also restores Health.
It is the same size as a standard hot spring, and can fully heal injured Pals.

GasMask.desc:
A mask with a special filtration system.

Accessory_ExplosionResist.desc:

It nullifies damage from explosions.Explosion Immunity

An advanced breeding facility of ancient civilization technology, enclosed in electronic glass.
It fully automates everything from egg production to incubation at high speed, and increases the inheritance rate of rare skills.
Pals are managed through holograms, it requires minimal pasture space.
